card.name: Space before a dose amount number
card.fires_on: The space just before a number in dosing instructions, after phrases like 'maintenance dose of', 'followed by', or 'at' a week interval. It predicts a dose amount or interval figure comes next.

modes.label: Before maintenance dose
modes.description: Space after 'dose of', 'dosing of', or 'followed by' that leads into the next dose amount.

modes.label: Before interval number
modes.description: Space after 'and at' before a week interval figure.

modes.label: Inside a number or dimension
modes.description: Occasionally a multiplication sign or a digit inside a number.
